verdict.rationale: IP India publishes the statutory First Schedule on its "Forms & Official Fees" page, with exact amounts by filing mode, so exact official fee figures are documented. Nothing in the evidence shows filing deadlines, late-filing or extension penalties, or any interest schedule for missed deadlines; the filing-process page is only a title. missing for 10: published filing deadlines with exact time limits, penalty/late-fee schedule for missed deadlines, interest terms, independent corroboration
